content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This architecture is a game-changer for digital creators in regions where payment processing platforms like Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are unavailable or severely restricted. By leveraging open-source tools and a cryptocurrency payment gateway, the solution provides a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives creators full control over their infrastructure. This means no more delayed payouts, no more platform restrictions, and no more dependence on third-party services. The result is a more secure, scalable, and efficient way to sell digital products, with complete ownership and control over the infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At the heart of this architecture is a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook triggers the Cloudflare Workers, which then updates the Supabase database with the order details. Meanwhile, the GitHub Pages-hosted storefront is updated in real-time, reflecting the new order. This seamless integration allows for instant product delivery and automatic payment processing, all without relying on third-party payment processors.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This architecture is specifically designed for digital creators in emerging markets, where payment processing platforms are often unreliable or unavailable. By providing a sovereign digital commerce stack, creators can finally break free from the limitations of traditional payment infrastructure and focus on growing their business. Whether you're selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software, this architecture gives you the flexibility and control you need to succeed.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10 in network fees — no payout schedule, no minimum threshold.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edger Commerce Stack ($197) is a key component of this architecture, providing a pre-configured and pre-tested combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours, with 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. The result is a reliable, scalable, and secure digital commerce infrastructure that's perfect for creators who need a robust payment solution.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The transaction log in a COREMERCH deployment provides a complete, independently verifiable audit trail of every payment. Each entry includes the transaction hash, which links directly to the public blockchain record. You can verify any transaction independently on Tronscan, Etherscan, Solscan, or the relevant blockchain explorer — no platform intermediary required. If a buyer claims they paid but the transaction does not appear in your order log, you check the blockchain directly. This level of cryptographic verifiability is structurally impossible with conventional payment processors.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
Your revenue lands in a wallet you control the moment the transaction confirms on-chain.

Visit our shop at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy this architecture today, follow these concrete steps: purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), deploy the stack in 48 hours, configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC, load 5 products, and test end-to-end before handing off to customers. Additionally, be sure to integrate NOWPayments into your storefront and configure the payment options to suit your needs. With these steps in place, you'll be ready to take on the demands of your growing business.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the average transaction fee for USDT on Tron?
The average transaction fee for USDT on Tron is under $0.10, making it an extremely cost-effective option for creators looking to receive cryptocurrency payments.
Can I use this architecture with multiple cryptocurrencies?
Yes, you can use this architecture with any cryptocurrency supported by NOWPayments, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and over 300 others.
How do I configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC on my storefront?

To configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC on your storefront, you'll need to update your DNS records to include the necessary TXT records. This will help to prevent email spoofing and ensure that your emails are delivered to your customers' inboxes.
Can I use this architecture with Gumroad or PayPal?

No, this architecture is specifically designed to bypass traditional payment processors like Gumroad and PayPal, providing a sovereign digital commerce stack that gives creators full control over their infrastructure.
How do I integrate NOWPayments into my storefront?

To integrate NOWPayments into your storefront, you'll need to follow the instructions provided by NOWPayments, which include generating a public key and updating your storefront code to include the necessary payment options.
What is the average Solana transaction fee?
The average Solana transaction fee is fractions of a cent, making it an extremely cost-effective option for creators looking to receive cryptocurrency payments.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction — the only fee between your buyer's payment and your wallet.
